metaDescription: Build an image sitemap from page and image URLs, with the Google image namespace and the 1,000 image limit checked. Free.
intro: Turns lines of page URL and image URLs into an image sitemap.
why:
Image sitemaps help search engines find images that scripts or galleries hide. The markup needs the image namespace and one image:image per image.

Google supports image:loc only now. The older title, caption, geo and license tags are no longer documented, so this tool does not write them.
howTo: Write one page per line: page URL, then image URLs separated by |.
Save it as sitemap-images.xml and submit it.

faq.a: Up to 1,000 image tags per URL.

faq.q: Can images be on another domain?
faq.a: Yes, if both domains are verified in Search Console.
Google no longer documents image:caption, title, geo_location or license.
Yes. Do not block images you want indexed.
